a2-01.title: Communicative Challenge: My Day
a2-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg about her typical weekday. You (Meg) get up, shower and have breakfast in the morning, and you go to bed early in the evening.
a2-01.prompt: Tell Károly what you do in the morning and when you go to bed.
cues: Say you get up, shower and have breakfast
Say you go to bed early in the evening
a2-01.target: Reggel felkelek, zuhanyozom, és reggelizem. Este korán lefekszem.
a2-01.english: In the morning I get up, shower, and have breakfast. In the evening I go to bed early.
a2-01.canDo: I can describe the main events of a typical day.

a2-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Getting Ready
a2-02.scenario: Károly wants to know how Meg gets ready in the morning. You (Meg) first wash up and brush your teeth, then get dressed, and finally have breakfast.
a2-02.prompt: Describe your morning routine to Károly in order: wash up and brush your teeth, then get dressed, and finally have breakfast.
cues: Say what you do after that
Say what you do in the end
a2-02.target: Előbb mosakodom, aztán fogat mosok. Utána felöltözöm, végül reggelizem.
a2-02.english: First I wash up, then I brush my teeth. After that I get dressed, finally I have breakfast.
a2-02.canDo: I can describe how I get ready in the morning.

a2-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Day?
a2-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she does during the week. You (Meg) work on Tuesday, but on Saturday you have a day off.
a2-03.prompt: Tell Károly that you work on Tuesday, and that you do not work on Saturday because it is your day off.
cues: Say what you do on Tuesday
Say you do not work on Saturday and give the reason
a2-03.target: Kedden dolgozom. Szombaton nem dolgozom, mert szabadnapom van.
a2-03.english: I work on Tuesday. I don't work on Saturday because I have a day off.
a2-03.canDo: I can say what I do on a particular day of the week.

a2-04.title: Communicative Challenge: How Often?
a2-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg how often she does sports and goes to the cinema. You (Meg) do sports twice a week and go to the cinema once a month.
a2-04.prompt: Answer Károly: say how many times a week you do sports and how many times a month you go to the cinema.
cues: Say how often you do sports
Say how often you go to the cinema
a2-04.target: Hetente kétszer sportolok, havonta egyszer moziba megyek.
a2-04.english: I do sports twice a week, I go to the cinema once a month.
a2-04.canDo: I can say how many times something happens.

a2-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Nine to Five
a2-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg about her working day. You (Meg) work from nine to five, and in the evening you are tired, so you rest.
a2-05.prompt: Tell Károly the hours you work, and that in the evening you are tired and so you rest.
cues: Say from when to when you work
Say you are tired in the evening and what you do because of it
a2-05.target: Kilenctől ötig dolgozom. Este fáradt vagyok, ezért pihenek.
a2-05.english: I work from nine to five. In the evening I am tired, so I rest.
a2-05.canDo: I can describe a span of time from one point to another.

a2-05-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Whole Day
a2-05-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg to describe a whole weekday and weekend. You (Meg) get up at seven, work from nine to five on weekdays, and sleep for a long time on the weekend.
a2-05-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly when you get up, when you work on weekdays, and what you do on the weekend.
cues: Say what time you get up
Say when you work on weekdays
Say you sleep for a long time on the weekend
a2-05-consolidation.target: Hétkor felkelek, hétköznap kilenctől ötig dolgozom. Hétvégén sokáig alszom.
a2-05-consolidation.english: I get up at seven, on weekdays I work from nine to five. On the weekend I sleep for a long time.
a2-05-consolidation.canDo: I can describe a full daily routine from getting up to going to bed.
